text_block_list.text: One day, with Valentine's Day fast approaching...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmm hum hum~♪ Choco-choco-choco-late~♪
Yummy chocolate~♪ Hmm hmm huuum~♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Fufufuun... fufu... gufufu...
Guhehehehehe~~~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hey, minion! Are you theeeere~?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hehehehe~! I've come again today~! Rawr!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Wh-what do you mean, 'what'...? Well, you see...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I was just bored,
so I came to check on you!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
N-Not at all! There's no such thing, nanoda!
There isn't, I say, there isn't—!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Still, um... well... uh...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...! Hehehe... All right!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaah!!! It's a UFO~~~~!!!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Now's the time! *land*!
Looking back inside from the empty window...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: U-Ugaaaah-!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: You turned around too fast, I say~~~~!!!!

Shinko Windy slammed the box onto the desk.
A sweet aroma drifted from the cracks of the crushed box.
Opening it, inside was what appeared to be homemade—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Gh…… grrrgh……!
And here I was gonna sneak it in and pretend I knew nothing about it~~~!
choice_data_list: Ah, for Valentine's? Is that for me?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Guuuuughhhh...! What are you laughing at?! That pisses me off...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I-It's no gooood!
Because this is...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Um! Er, well...!
~~~~~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I-I brought it just so I could show it off to youuuu!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Gwahaha!
Ahhhh, this is delicious~~!!"
After popping a chocolate into her mouth, Shinko Windy flashed a smug, satisfied grin.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"How's that~! Aren't you jealous~?!
These chocolates made by Windy-chan are suuuuper delicious~!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, that was so delicious~!
My cheeks are gonna fall off, indeed~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... What a poor soul you are,
not being able to eat this..."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Well, if you really want some that badly,
I suppose I could share a little with you...?

This is probably...
Probably what's going on.
Right now...
choice_data_list: I-I really want to eat some~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ho-ho~w, you wanna eat it~?
Guhehehe...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"If you insist, then I have no choice.
As a special treat, I shall bestow the rest upon you!"
choice_data_list: Well then, thank you for the food.

text_block_list.text:
I pop a piece of chocolate into my mouth.
A sweet, delicious flavor spreads, and... wait, what!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...! Pwahahaha!
You totally fell for it~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Surprised, huh?! It's Windy-chan's special mustard-filled chocolate!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Was it really that spicy?
Did I add too much?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Only that one was spicy, so don't worry nanoda.
Hurry up and eat the others nodatsu."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe... Still, to think you'd
hit the jackpot on your very first try...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: You really are so hilarious~!

The rest of the chocolates were absolutely delicious.
And so, with a grateful heart,
I accepted her Valentine's chocolates.

This is probably...
Probably what's going on.
Usually I'd play along, but...
If she stays like this forever, won't she have trouble when she grows up? I felt that spoiling her too much wouldn't be good for her upbringing.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, what's the matter~?
Don't you want to eat it?
Even though it's sooo delicious!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, maybe Windy-chan should just
eat it aaallll uuup~~~?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Y-You don't want it?
Even though I went out of my way
to say I'd give it to you...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
It turned out so delicious...!
Super, suuuuper delicious!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Windy-chan, worked hard, to make it...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
U-Uuu...
Uuuuuuughhhhh~~~...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you really sure!
Windy-chan's gonna eat it all, you know!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmph, so there!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: What is the meaning of thiiis?! Aaaarrrrgh!

It seems I went too far.
Feeling a bit apologetic, I search for the right words to draw out her true feelings...
choice_data_list: Don't tell me, you're here to show off your cooking skills to me...!?
Don't tell me, you're here to show off your cooking skills to me...!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
T-That is correct!
Impressive of you to see through it, hahah!
choice_data_list: Kuh! Is that why you were trying to feed it to me?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, since we've been found out, it can't be helped.
If it's come to this, we have no choice but to hand it over head-on.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Come on! Eat that chocolate!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Bow down before
Windy-chan's snack-making skills~!"
choice_data_list: Got it, then I'll take it.
Got it, then I'll take it then!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Yep! I give this to you! Eat it and be amazed, nanoda!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
............
H... How is it~? Is it tasty~?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe...! Right, right?!
Eat up, eat lots!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ah, but make sure to savor it while you eat!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
This is your... this is a special chocolate
made just for you, okay?! Hmph!

She's still as stubborn as ever...
But her feelings came through loud and clear.
The slightly misshapen chocolate was delicious.
